TDECK-PLUS-R2-LAB-USB-INITIAL-HARDWARE
PR #259 LILYGO T-Deck Plus ESP32-S3 laboratory firmware publication. Exact-head PR CI must PASS before lab release pipeline; build full stable release profiles plus isolated T-Deck Plus target. Package separate tdeck-plus firmware.bin, bootloader.bin, partitions.bin and boot_app0 as ESP32-S3 manifest entries (bootloader offset 0x0, partitions 0x8000, otadata 0xE000, firmware 0x10000). Publish as hidden LAB option accessible only via ?lab=1. Must preserve live production pages without altering production firmware binaries. Gate site artifact checks; don't create public GitHub Release, tag, merge or release to production. Physical hardware not verified. R2 is limited to Wi-Fi signature scanning and T-Deck Plus hardware diagnostics.
